policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (component 13, audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (component 12, data scope). They are independent: a viewer can be correctly entitled and correctly see zero rows.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen — "sees 8 of 60" — is derived from the roster at paint time. No count is stored. A stated count stops being true the moment the roster changes and nothing notices.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one BASIS field plus the values of it they may see. A separate boolean mask hides row-level money while leaving totals visible.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values maps to a definite, non-empty set of the roster. Continuous measures — forecast, EAC variance, percent complete — are excluded: a rule on them re-resolves every week, which makes it a filter, not an access rule.

policies.name: No approval
policies.desc: There is no approval queue. Publishing, granting and revoking are immediate and logged. (Superseded the earlier CAPEX draft, which carried a six-item approval queue.)

policies.name: Admin holds none
policies.desc: The platform administrator administers entitlement and does not thereby acquire it. Their zero scope is by design, not omission.

policies.name: Publishing never widens
policies.desc: Adding a reader to an artifact grants existence, never rows. The reader opens it under their own rule.
